summary: Toronto-Dominion Bank filed a preliminary pricing supplement under Form 424B5 for a proposed offering of USD-denominated Senior Medium-Term Notes, Series F. The notes are unsecured, bail-inable securities not listed on any exchange, offered via TD Securities. No specific price, coupon, or maturity is stated in the excerpt. This is a routine debt capital markets transaction, not a special situation. The filing does not involve an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change.
